fields.description: Skyscape Avenue is the Tower B residential offering in Sobha Hartland II’s Skyscape collection. Its one- to three-bedroom apartments include additional study, library, store and maid-room configurations, with different lagoon, community and city-facing layouts.

overview: A marketed fractional-bedroom category does not mean an additional full bedroom: the reviewed document distinguishes study, library, store and service rooms. Compare the selected drawing and suite area rather than relying on the headline category.
research.locationNote: Sobha Hartland II, Dubai. Different layouts face the lagoons, surrounding community, Nad Al Sheba or the wider skyline. Confirm the chosen level, orientation and actual access rights to community facilities.
research.priceNote: Sobha currently advertises AED 1.95 m, subject to inventory. Property Finder’s AED 1.7 m launch guide and sold-out flag are separate portal references; they do not establish the current developer allocation or unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 20% down payment at launch, 40% construction and 40% handover. No current dated developer instalment calendar was retrieved; obtain the selected unit’s written terms and remaining balance.
research.handoverNote: Estimated timing; confirm the signed unit agreement.
